paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gamsung a thahsa mi ana om a, athatmi theih louh ahihleh,
heading: Athattu Theih Louh Tualthahna Toh Kisai
english: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

paite: na upate uh leh na vaihawmtute uh ahong pai ding ua, athahna kim khua a pan ateh ding ua,
english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

paite: huan hichi ahi ding a, aluang a pan kho naipen khua a upate'n bawnghon lak a bawngla, zat nai louh, hakkol po nai lou akai ding uhi.
english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

paite: Huai khua upate'n bawngla, tui luanna, lei leh louh leh bangmah chinlouhna phaizang ah akaisuk ding ua, phaizang ah angawng atan ding uh.
english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

paite: Levi tapa siampute'n ahon zuan ding ua, amau TOUPA na Pathian un anasemmi leh TOUPA min a vualzawlmi dia asehte uh lah ahi ngal ua; thubuai leh kivuak thu agen bangbang uh ahi ding ahi.
english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

paite: Luang naihpen khua upa tengteng in phaizang a bawngla ngawng atan tung uah akhut uh asil ding uhi.
english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

paite: "Ka khut un hiai sisan asuah kei a, ka mit un leng amu sam kei.
english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

paite: TOUPA aw, na tatkhiak, na mi Israelte lak ah poi khoih lou sisan suahna moh hon khusak ke'n," chi in apang ding uhi. Huchi in sisan thu ah ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
english: Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in poi khoih lou sisan suahna na lak ua kipan na koihmang ding uhi.
english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

paite: Na melmate uh dou dia na kipatkhiak ua, TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak a, sal a na pi ua,
heading: Galmat Numei Toh Kisai
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

paite: sal lak a numei melhoihtak, na mi deihlam, zi ding a na mi deihlamtak na muhleh,
english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

paite: na inn ah na pi dia; alu amet dia, akhutchin atan ding hi.
english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

paite: Asal puanak asuahkhe dia, na inn ah a-om dia, kha khat sung anu leh apa asuun dia, huai khit in, na kithuahpih dia, apasal na hi dia, amah na zi ahi ding hi.
english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

paite: Amah a kipahna na neih keileh a-utna peuh a pai na phal ding ahi, sum-le-pai in na zuak ding ahi kei a, sumsinna in na zang ding leng ahi kei, amah na daisakta ngal a.
english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

paite: Mi'n zi nih nei henla, khat pen deih in khat pen ho taleh, adeihnu leh ahuatnu in ta suansak tuak taleh; a upapen ahuatnu tapa hitaleh;
heading: Tapa Khatna Goutan Toh Kisai
english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

paite: agou neih atapate akhopsak hun chiang in adeihpen tapa, atapa upa ahuat pen ta sang a deihsakna apiak tuam ding ahi kei.
english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

paite: Ahuat pen ta, ata upapen, aneih tengteng a pan tan nih huai a dia abawl ding ahi; ahatna bul ahi a, tachil hihna ama a tuam ahi.
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

paite: Mi'n tapa phengphitak, helhattak nei henla, anu leh apa thumang lou in, asawina uh limsakta keileh;
heading: Thumang Lou Tapa Toh Kisai
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

paite: anu leh apa'n akai ding ua, akho upate uh kiang ah akhokulh kongpi bul ah api ding uhi.
english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

paite: Akho upate uh kiang ah, hiai ka tapa uh phengphitak leh helhattak ahi a, ka thu uh leng amang nuam kei a; kizatbei hat leh kham hatmi ahi, achi ding uhi.
english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

paite: Huchi in khua a mi tengteng in suang in adenglum ding uhi. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi. Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding uhi.
english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

paite: Mi'n sihna khop khelhna ahih a, thah a om a, sing dawn a na khai uleh;
heading: Dan Tuamtuam
english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

paite: aluang sing ah zankhua in a-om ding ahi kei. Huai ni mahmah in na vui ding uhi. Sing a khai peuhmah lah Pathian hamsethuak ahi ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un luah ding a ahon piak na gam uh na hihnitlouhna ding un.
english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.
